# Selected-route scientific comparison boundary

**Decision:** Retain Space Bunny as the only currently observed exact-zero route
that completed a full local campaign research run, but do not call it a
scientifically qualified replacement or a reliable default from one run. The
owner directed us to stop broad model benchmarking. This audit uses existing
artifacts and makes **zero new provider calls**; it does not substitute those
artifacts for the missing matched comparison.

| Boundary | Evidence now | What it establishes | Remaining comparison |
|---|---|---|---|
| Public research run | [Same-run assessment](m12-space-bunny-full-run-assessment-2026-09-27.md) and [persisted evaluation](m12-space-bunny-persisted-evals-2026-09-27.json): 75/75 tasks; 48 assessed claims, with 3 supports, 6 partial and 39 insufficient; 11 claim-batch deterministic fallbacks and two ranking-tie fallbacks. | Operational completion, durable recovery and descriptive claim-support limits. Central mechanisms are speculative. | No identical-input baseline/candidate trial or repeat-run reliability estimate exists. |
| Citation and safety offline controls | `make eval-smoke` passed on the reviewed PR #60 code; M12-02a's [offline receipt](m12-offline-verification-2026-09-27.json) records earlier integrated-code checks. | Deterministic evaluator and release-control behavior; no Space Bunny quality measurement. | A selected-model citation/claim challenge is absent. |
| Frozen model screens | [M1 qualification inventory](baseline/model-qualification/README.md) and [Sante preregistration](baseline/model-qualification/ling-sante-scientific-prereg-v1.json) retain public challenge inputs, three-trial gates, served-model and cost rules. | Comparable inputs and an existing evaluation contract, but earlier candidate outputs cannot be relabeled as Space Bunny results. | A new route-specific preregistration and three fresh paired trials would be needed before a quality claim; stop on first failed prerequisite and never loosen thresholds. |
| Novelty and Robin effects | The [M11 register](m11-follow-up-register.md) retains the distinct result-conditioned novelty pilot and the unobserved deployed Robin refinement. | Existing offline behavior and release records only. | Neither adaptation has a selected-route matched live comparison or production refinement observation. |

The first minimal future screen, if the owner reauthorizes live model comparison,
is the existing four-claim batch schema on the fixed public inputs, with three
fresh isolated trials, exact served-model and usage evidence, fresh zero-price
admission, and no fallback. Only if that passes should the fixed 30-item
citation/claim challenge run under its preregistered accuracy, contradiction
recall and provenance gates. The route-specific protocol must be committed
before calls. This is a dependency statement, **not** an authorization to
resume the expensive screening loop now.

**Current result:** M12-02b3a's descriptive/offline audit is complete. The
M12-02b3b selected-route scientific comparison remains **inconclusive and open**. No
expert or wet-lab validation exists, and a report Elo score or its
`verified_count=3` badge cannot fill that gap.
